findings.evidence: template/scripts/model_routing.py:1166–1175 exempts `_unlaunched_attempt` from the existing-execution refusal; lines 1647–1651 also permit retained finalization of that receipt. The added requirement in openspec/changes/owner-approved-supervisor-diff/specs/model-routing/spec.md:5 explicitly requires refusal, writing nothing, when 'an execution exists', and design.md:9 requires 'no execution recorded'. Meanwhile, the delta's 'Unlaunched Codex attempt' scenario permits explicit owner-approved retention after such an attempt. The candidate implements that exception without reconciling the contradictory requirement and design.
findings.summary: Owner-approved retention accepts an existing unlaunched execution despite the explicit no-execution precondition.
